items.topic: Taro version, source and risk disposition
currentFacts: Taro 4.3.2 isolated candidate passed application strict type checking and synthetic weapp build with React/DOM/types 18.3.1, TypeScript 5.9.3 and Webpack 5.91.0.
Third-party declaration diagnostics and npm audit advisories remain; affected-package counts are not proof of product exploitability or remediation.
Remote template fetch evaluates creator modules; the license-unknown Gitee template was not adopted; full interactive init and malicious archive validation were not performed.
items.riskLocation: development-tooling-and-template-bootstrap; actual product runtime reachability is not yet established
items.whyCurrentStage: SP01 requires candidate source, risk treatment and confirmation of key technical choices.

recommendedPath.bootstrap: project-controlled-local-scaffold; do not execute remote template creator modules or use the license-unknown Gitee template
recommendedPath.riskDisposition: development-candidate only; perform bounded package reachability review against the actual graph at SP08; any confirmed applicable reachable critical issue blocks its affected integration/release gate

items.minimumNextStep: Carry the confirmed candidate and guardrails into SP01 signoff; create the formal dependency lock in SP07 and review actual package reachability at SP08.
items.exitCriteria: SP01 candidate/source/bootstrap choice and bounded risk treatment are confirmed. This does not claim advisories fixed, malicious-archive evidence passed, or product security accepted.

items.whyCurrentStage: Preparation decisions are recorded; formal product-state and boundary checks depend on implementation.
items.minimumNextStep: Carry existing preparation evidence into SP01 signoff; do not create the formal shared package now.
items.exitCriteria: Reference existing evidence at signoff; retain product implementation checks in SP07/SP08.

items.topic: device performance sampling and QP05 product evidence
items.whyCurrentStage: SP01 records known devices and method limits; actual page frame/input traces require product pages.
items.trigger: After relevant product pages and content fixtures exist.
items.originalThreshold: QP05: each applicable device group 3 rounds, each at least 30 timed segments with frozen segment duration and 200 records plus legal heavy content; each segment average at least 55 FPS with no app-attributable jank over 100 ms; retain frame/input traces, long-frame detail, per-segment statistics and recording.
items.minimumNextStep: Keep the unavailable independent iOS frame stream and Android host-layer limitation recorded; execute QP05 only against the actual product page.
items.exitCriteria: All QP05 groups and rounds satisfy the original threshold with raw evidence; otherwise SP35 remains blocked.

currentFacts: Home Wi-Fi has 30 successful read-only CloudBase application round trips.
Pakomo UI shows a WeChat-only light profile with 100 ms delay, 30 ms jitter, 1 percent packet loss and 2048/1024 Kbps; exact per-request application was not proven by retained samples.
Public Wi-Fi and cellular observations remain separate diagnostic samples and do not establish stable ranges or CloudBase link metrics.
items.whyCurrentStage: SP01/QM01 needs a confirmed reproducible normal/weak test configuration and evidence method; product recovery outcomes belong to later cards.

recommendedPath.controlledWeak: Pakomo light profile applied only to WeChat using the visible 100/30/1%, 2048/1024 Kbps settings
recommendedPath.publicWifi: supplemental real-world scenario, not the controlled QP07 injection profile

items.minimumNextStep: Carry the confirmed profile split and evidence boundaries into SP01 signoff; keep actual per-request shaping and product-path recovery unproven until QP07.
items.exitCriteria: SP01 test profiles and scope are confirmed. No claim is made that Pakomo settings were independently proven effective or that product recovery passed.

downstreamValidation.trigger: When real read, write, query and image paths exist.
downstreamValidation.originalThreshold: Inject the frozen rate/latency/loss settings before and after each applicable path and execute 3 rounds per scenario; preserve state/input and prevent duplicate business effects; missing configuration/evidence or any failure blocks the affected task and final acceptance.

items.topic: endurance workload and product memory budget
items.whyCurrentStage: The user confirmed the preparation workload; actual loop and attributable memory growth need product pages.
items.trigger: After product pages and repeated user-flow loop are implemented.
items.originalThreshold: QP08: 60 minutes, at least 60 full mixed-user cycles, record every 10 minutes; no crash/blank screen/uncaught exception/duplicate business effect; resource/memory must satisfy a user-confirmed measured budget with no sustained leak.
items.minimumNextStep: SP05 defines the actual loop; propose numeric memory growth budget from product measurement for user confirmation.
items.exitCriteria: The confirmed budget and raw 60-minute product run pass; otherwise SP35 remains blocked.

items.topic: E06 current recovery capability, plan and cost
currentFacts: User-reported read-only console view showed a backup/rollback entry, no data and no warning.
That observation does not establish the active target plan, rollback entitlement, retention, price or a tested alternative.
No current cloud query or restore action was performed in this review.
items.whyCurrentStage: E06 is an explicit SP01 evidence gate and must establish a recovery path before proceeding to product data stages.
items.minimumNextStep: User provides read-only target environment plan/entitlement details and visible backup/rollback retention/cost; if unavailable, report 'not displayed' and provide the existing export/restore capability view.
items.exitCriteria: Target plan is mapped; rollback/backup entitlement, retention and cost are explicit; a feasible fallback with limitations is documented. Do not perform a real business-data restore before such data exists.
items.downstreamTrigger: After isolated business-shaped data and authorization/fund relationships exist.
items.downstreamOriginalThreshold: Actual restore must preserve object relationships, authorization, funds, inventory, versions and messages; must not revive cancelled/expired/revoked states or double count/refund. Failure blocks the relevant stage/final release.

items.topic: stage signoff and SP01-S06 to SP07 gate
items.whyCurrentStage: QD03 is the aggregate review of task prerequisites and confirmations; it is not a separate technical cause beyond open A/B items.
items.minimumNextStep: Close current A/B items and verify SP01-S06 deliverables/dependencies.
items.exitCriteria: Only record signoff when the original prerequisites, confirmations and E06 gate are actually satisfied.

items.whyCurrentStage: The user confirmed the project-controlled local scaffold. The unverified test only applies if remote ZIP/archive template execution is later selected; it is not passed or removed.
items.minimumNextStep: Preserve the test unchanged; before any future remote archive path is enabled, run the isolated test and produce the required evidence.
items.exitCriteria: Current SP01 bootstrap choice excludes remote archive execution. If a future task reintroduces it, require real isolated evidence, passing test and cleanup before enabling that path.
